route.title: DAILY FARMING ROUTE (8 STOPS)
route.hint: Tap a stop to go there and focus the map on it:

1.name: Dara's Orchard (cherry trees)
1.action: Pick Grey Cherries from the northern trees and look for Hollis's Lost Hen.

2.name: Town plots
2.action: Harvest the ripe vegetables and buy seeds at Hazel's shop to replant.
2.loot: Carrots, Potatoes or Wheat • Farming XP

3.name: River and Central Bridge
3.action: Fish the river's swirls by day for Carp, Perch and Chub.

4.name: Whisperwood entrance
4.action: Chop logs and fallen oaks at the forest edge to stock up on wood for crafting.

5.name: Mushroom Dell
5.action: Walk in the shade of the giant south-west oaks to gather wild Silvercap mushrooms.

6.name: The Hidden Glade
6.action: Walk between the old columns to pick the purple Glowcap mushrooms and trace the arch's runes.

7.name: Moonmere Lake (altar and pier)
7.action: Fish the deep northern water (Tiger Trout / Ghost Fish) and leave offerings at the shrine.

8.name: Tamsin's Bakery or your cottage
8.action: Use the stove to cook the day's fish and mushrooms and fill Odette's orders.
